name: Mauritius Vanilla Black Tea
where: Bois Chéri shops at Caudan Waterfront and supermarkets
about: A black tea blended with vanilla, made in Mauritius. It is a popular gift that reflects the island's tea and flavor traditions.
tip: Tins cost more than paper boxes, and prices at the airport are higher than in town.

name: Mauritius Spiced Rum
about: A rum made from Mauritian sugarcane. It is one of the island's best-known local drinks.
tip: Choose vanilla or lychee flavors, depending on your taste.
